title: Index the reconciliation matcher without changing pairings
carries: The pairings must stay identical to the current matcher (finance diffs them month over month).

Indexing by amount and choosing the closest day, or bucketing by (amount, day), changes about a tenth of the production pairs: the current rule is the first free ledger entry in ledger order that fits the tolerance. What works is a per-amount list of free ledger indices scanned in ledger order.
why_not_in_repo: The pairing requirement was stated in session 1 only, and the production replay that showed which indexing variants break it is deleted between the sessions. The docstring does describe the first-fit rule, but the natural indexed rewrite (closest day) looks equally valid and passes every visible test.

learn: Rule: the pairings from recon.match.reconcile must stay exactly what the current code produces because finance diffs them month over month.

Failed: indexing ledger entries by amount and picking the closest day changes about 10 percent of the production pairs, and so does bucketing by amount and day. Works: keep a list of free ledger indices per amount in ledger order and take the first that fits the tolerance.
stub.recall_query: reconcile indexing pairings identical closest day first free ledger entry
